name: School, Life & Sex
source:
You play as a young guy called Jackson. His real parents died during a car accident when he was 14 years old. Now he lives with his stepmother and stepsister in a small apartment. Take your chance and build special relationships with the girls you meet ingame. All the characters will have their own personalities, secrets and desires.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/PORNO]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演名叫杰克逊的年轻人。他14岁时，亲生父母在车祸中去世。现在，他与继母和继姐住在一间小公寓里。把握机会，与游戏中遇见的女孩建立特殊关系。所有角色都有自己的性格、秘密与欲望。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/PORNO]Patreon[/url]]
